meta.name: Firefly Wedding
meta.description: Satoko Kirigaya has everything a noblewoman could want—except time. With her life running out, she’s determined to marry well and make her father proud. But when a ruthless assassin kidnaps her, she makes a desperate offer: “Marry me, and we’ll have it all.” Shinpei Goto accepts, only to become dangerously obsessed. Now Satoko must choose between duty and a love that could consume them both.

videos.title: An Unwanted Repayment
videos.overview: A frail young lady finds herself kidnapped. Her only hope is to win over a man hired to kill her.

videos.title: Tennyo Island
videos.overview: Satoko struggles to keep on her dangerous rescuer's good side while learning about her predicament.

videos.title: A Watchful Rat
videos.overview: Satoko agrees to Shinpei's plan: Become a courtesan and convince a wealthy man to buy her out.

videos.title: I'll Set You Free
videos.overview: Satoko grapples with Shinpei's violent tendencies and her own feelings.

videos.title: Hurt
videos.overview: Shinpei's attentions to Satoko earn her the courtesans' ire.

videos.title: Honest Feelings
videos.overview: Yukari's jealousy tests Satoko's resolve to protect herself, and a friendship masks darker motives.

videos.title: A Devil and His Heart
videos.overview: Satoko and Shinpei set sail for the mainland, but the island's gangsters won't let them go without a fight.
